acceptance_criteria.criterion: Both card list and detailed list pages show pagination controls when there are more than 20 matching comics
Pagination controls are hidden when there are 20 or fewer matching comics
Clicking a pagination link navigates to the correct page of results
The cl_page query parameter is used (not page)
Pagination controls follow Bootstrap 5 pagination markup
Previous/Next links are disabled at the boundaries
Large page counts show ellipsis gaps instead of all page numbers
Applying a new filter resets pagination to page 1

summary: Added ArrayPagination import to DetailedListPage. Updated _render() to create ArrayPagination($comics, 20, null, 'cl_page') and pass sliced items to generateComicList(). Added private renderPagination() method with Bootstrap 5 pagination markup including ellipsis windowing (first 2, last 2, 2 around current page), disabled previous/next at boundaries, and active class on current page. Since CardListPage inherits _render() from DetailedListPage, both pages get pagination automatically. PHPStan passes, all 60 tests pass.

summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified — implementation is correct and complete.
Build & Runtime: PHP 8.4 syntax valid, no parse errors.
Regression: All 60 tests pass (0 failures). No regressions introduced.
PHPStan: 0 errors on full 138-file analysis.
AC1: CardListPage extends DetailedListPage and inherits _render(), pagination applied polymorphically via generateComicList() override.
AC2: renderPagination() returns early when totalItems <= itemsPerPage (i.e., <=20).
AC3: ArrayPagination::getPageURL() builds correct URLs; getSlicedItems() returns correct slice for current page.
AC4: Constructor explicitly passes 'cl_page' as page parameter — verified against ArrayPagination source.
AC5: Full Bootstrap 5 pagination markup: nav, ul.pagination.justify-content-center, li.page-item, a.page-link.
AC6: disabled class applied on Previous when current===1, on Next when current===totalPages.
AC7: Windowed ellipsis logic shows pages 1-2, [current-2..current+2], and last 2 pages; gaps rendered as disabled ellipsis spans.
AC8: applyFilters() redirects to getURL() without cl_page — ArrayPagination defaults to page 1 when cl_page is absent.

comments.note: Disabled Previous/Next pagination links still carry a functional href (getPageURL(0) or getPageURL(totalPages+1)). Bootstrap CSS prevents interaction visually, but using href='#' with aria-disabled='true' would be more semantically correct per accessibility best practices. Not a failing AC.

No dedicated unit tests target the renderPagination() logic. Testing the windowed ellipsis algorithm, boundary conditions (0 items, exactly 20, exactly 21), and page clamping in isolation would improve confidence. Not blocking — no AC requires new tests.

summary: Code review PASS. Implementation is clean, correct, and follows established project patterns. No blocking issues found.

Architecture: ArrayPagination from the existing application-utils library is used correctly with 'cl_page' parameter. The getSlicedItems() + generateComicList() pattern cleanly limits rendered output to the current page. CardListPage.generateComicList() override is correctly invoked via the inherited _render(), giving both pages pagination with zero code duplication.
Security: htmlspecialchars() correctly applied to all getPageURL() outputs — no XSS risk. No new attack surfaces introduced.
Windowed ellipsis algorithm: the $show array keyed by page number with $prevShown gap detection is compact, readable, and correct for the first-2 / last-2 / ±2-around-current window.

Accessibility concern: disabled Previous/Next links carry real href values; Bootstrap pointer-events:none blocks mouse clicks but not keyboard navigation. The ARIA-correct pattern (href='#' + aria-disabled='true' + tabindex='-1') should be used in a future accessibility pass. Non-blocking.
Minor dead code: the 'if($totalPages <= 1)' guard in renderPagination() is unreachable — the preceding 'if($totalItems <= $itemsPerPage)' check is sufficient. Non-blocking.
All 8 acceptance criteria fully implemented and verified by QA. 60/60 tests pass.

comments.note: The second early-return guard in renderPagination() — 'if($totalPages <= 1) return' — is unreachable dead code. The preceding guard 'if($totalItems <= $itemsPerPage) return' is sufficient: if totalItems > itemsPerPage, then ceil(totalItems/itemsPerPage) is always >= 2. The redundant check is harmless but should be removed in a cleanup pass.

Disabled Previous/Next pagination links carry real navigable href values (getPageURL(0), getPageURL(totalPages+1)). Bootstrap's disabled class applies pointer-events:none but keyboard navigation (Tab + Enter) or direct URL access can still reach those URLs. Per ARIA spec, the accessible pattern is: href='#' + aria-disabled='true' + tabindex='-1'. Consider updating in a future accessibility pass.

The foreach variable in 'foreach($show as $p => $unused)' is informally named $unused since the value is always true. More idiomatic alternatives: foreach(array_keys($show) as $p) or using $_ as the throwaway variable. Minor readability item — not blocking.

renderPagination() is declared private, preventing subclasses from customizing pagination rendering. CardListPage inherits _render() and cannot override pagination without overriding the entire _render() method. Consider changing visibility to protected to align with the protected generateComicList() pattern.

No dedicated unit tests target renderPagination() logic: windowed ellipsis algorithm, boundary conditions (0 items, exactly 20, exactly 21), or page clamping. Not blocking — no AC requires new tests. A future PagePaginationTest class would improve confidence.
